source: nflverse/nfl4th (Baldwin's 4th-down bot, the official nflverse package)

decision_equation.decision_rule: go_boost = 100 * (go_wp - max(fg_wp, punt_wp)) — go if positive. max_non_go = max(fg_wp, punt_prob)
decision_equation.models: sysdata.rda holds the trained WP models (200, landed)

lesson: The 4th-down equation is a 3-branch max(·) over WP deltas with a 100x boost display. Our EDGE alt-ladder equivalent: the same structure applies to 2-point tries and onside kicks.
